paragraphs: Rabbi Yose Gelilaa, the Galilean. Shabbat 46a and Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:7 relate that he visited Rabbi Yose, son of Rabbi Chanina, and moved a lamp, to which Rabbi Yose bar Chanina objected. He and Rabbi Yonah always reported Rabbi Yose bar Chanina, as in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, at the end of 3:1; Kilayim, chapter 3; Shabbat 7:4; and Nazir 6:1.

notes.text: The Galilean form is retained for this Amoraic notice; it is not silently identified with the Tanna Yose HaGelili. The prefixed kaf in the Kilayim chapter 3 reference is citation syntax, not a new section designation.
